_README: Catalogue corrections ruled by Sascha, applied by convert-csv.js after the CSV parse. 'mergeInto' folds a duplicate record's awards into the surviving slug and drops the duplicate; 'set' patches fields on the surviving record.

merges.why: Same product (Prada makes one PradaScope mascara); publications printed different names. Ruled same-product by Sascha 2026-08-23.

prada-beauty-pradascope-lash-lengthening._why: The $72 on the Glamour-import record was wrong; correct price is $35 (Sascha 2026-08-23).
